title: Spot-Cleaning Rates for Households with Registered Animals: Security Deposit Account
content:
**Schedule note.** The spot-cleaning rate charged for each spot-cleaned room of a Security Deposit Account follows the animals registered on the lease under the Pet Addendum:

| Animals registered on the lease | Spot-cleaning rate per spot-cleaned room |
|---|---|
| A dog was registered | 60.00 USD |
| A cat was registered and no dog was | 55.00 USD |
| Neither a dog nor a cat was registered | the program's carpet spot-cleaning charge per room |

**Records read.** The species of each animal registered on the lease, taken from the lease's Pet Addendum records. A dog anywhere among those records settles the rate at 60.00 USD, whatever other animals are registered.

**How the rate is used.** The rate is charged once for each room that carries a spot-cleaning line. It enters the corrected cleaning charge as the rate times the number of spot-cleaned rooms.

### Combinations

| Dog registered | Cat registered | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 60.00 |
| yes | no | 60.00 |
| no | yes | 55.00 |
| no | no | the program's per-room charge |

**Hypothetical case.** A household with one cat and one dog registered under Pet Addendum records has spot-cleaning lines in two rooms. The spot-cleaning part of its corrected cleaning charge is two times 60.00, which is 120.00 USD.
